papers.authors: Yilan Chen, Zian Su, Manish Prajapat, Dingmin Wang, Rein Houthooft, Rui Song, Vijay Lingam
papers.evidence: 用于加权大模型蒸馏信号的双层优化框架
papers.tldr: 本文提出奖励对齐蒸馏（RAD）框架，旨在解决大语言模型在线策略蒸馏中对所有标记进行无差别监督的低效问题。RAD通过双层优化预测并加权每个标记对最终奖励的影响，从而调整蒸馏信号。实验表明，该方法在多个数学和代码基准测试中显著超越现有基准。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but remains computationally expensive and sample inefficient. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, yet standard OPD distills every token regardless of whether the teacher's preference actually improves task reward. Existing token-selection methods rely on proxies such as uncertainty or teacher--student divergence, which need not identify reward-improving supervision. We introduce Reward-Aligned Distillation (RAD), a bilevel framework that weights distillation signals based on their predicted effect on the student's post-update reward. RAD differentiates through a temporary optimizer step to score each token's supervision, then updates the token weights by projected ascent from the initial token weights. The resulting weights can strengthen, suppress, or reverse individual distillation-gradient contributions. At a matched training-response budget, RAD improves mean accuracy on six competition-math benchmarks over the strongest baselines by 6.5 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and 2.5 points for Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. RAD-Simple, a simplified variant, achieves comparable math accuracy at the same training-response budget. On LiveCodeBench-v6, RAD reaches 54.69\% and 58.67\% pass@1 with Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and OLMo3-7B-Instruct, respectively, exceeding the strongest baselines by 8.7 and 6.4 points. These results support reward-guided weighting of teacher supervision across model families and tasks.

papers.title_en: Probabilistic Multi-Source Data Selection via Learnable Categorical Priors: Variance Reduction and Guaranteed Derandomization
papers.authors: Shizhan Cai, Qixin Zhang, Siyuan Ma, Siyuan Liang, Yongcheng Jing, Dacheng Tao
papers.evidence: 多源双层数据选择的概率松弛
papers.tldr: 本文针对多源双层数据选择问题，提出了一种基于可学习分类先验的概率松弛新方法。该方法引入分类先验对可行数据子集进行参数化以实现无损舍入，设计了高效的两点梯度估计器和可约化表示，并开发了具有严格近似保证的随机梯度算法（ReSGD）。
papers.abstract_en: Bilevel data selection is a fundamental task with numerous applications in machine learning and statistics. A common strategy for tackling this problem is to relax the original bilevel combinatorial optimization into a continuous one. However, existing methods, including 0-1 relaxation and probabilistic relaxation, still suffer from several limitations, such as unstable gradient estimation and infeasible rounding. To address these issues, this paper proposes a new probabilistic relaxation for the multi-source bilevel data selection problem. Our key idea is to introduce multiple learnable categorical priors to parameterize a probability distribution supported only on feasible data subsets, thus naturally yielding a lossless rounding scheme. We further show that our proposed relaxation admits an effective two-point gradient estimator, which can simultaneously avoid the inverse-Hessian computation required by existing 0-1 relaxation and the unbounded score term appearing in prior probabilistic relaxation. Furthermore, we develop a reducible representation of this estimator, which substantially reduces the number of lower-level retrainings required for gradient computation. Built upon this reducible two-point estimator, we then design a novel stochastic gradient algorithm, termed ReSGD, for multi-source bilevel data selection problem, and establish a rigorous approximation guarantee for the subset returned by ReSGD under weak submodularity. Finally, extensive experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of our proposed ReSGD.

papers.title_en: Multilevel Monte Carlo for Zeroth-Order Stochastic Bilevel Optimization with Inexact Lower Level Solves
papers.authors: Neil K. Chada, Mohammad S. Salehi, Mathias Staudigl, Simon Weissmann
papers.evidence: 用于参数调优的随机双层优化
papers.tldr: 本文针对数学图像处理中变分正则化参数调优计算成本高的问题，研究了基于数据的双层优化方法。提出了一种多级蒙特卡洛无导数优化算法，结合高斯平滑与不同精度的下层求解，实现了高效的参数选择，并给出了端到端的复杂性分析。
papers.abstract_en: Variational regularization techniques are dominant in the field of mathematical imaging. The expressiveness of these methods heavily depends on the adopted regularization formulation which usually involves a number of parameters which have to be fine-tuned by the user. To circumvent the heavy computational costs associated with this parameter tuning, data-driven learning strategies have turned out to be a useful strategy. Selecting parameters by learning from data gives rise to a hierarchical (bilevel) optimization problem, which is in general computationally hard to solve. Our aim in this paper is to develop a data-efficient solution strategy for the bilevel learning problem. To that end, we propose a multilevel Monte Carlo derivative-free optimization method that couples Gaussian smoothing of the upper-level objective (parameter selection) with a hierarchy of lower-level (variational regularization) solution accuracies. Being agnostic towards the specific way the lower-level problem is solved, we derive explicit oracle complexity and computational cost statements for approximately solving the entire bilevel learning problem. Our statements are parameterized by the employed lower-level solution method, thus allowing for a direct cost accounting from the variational reconstruction method to the parameter selection problem. This enables us to give a universal end-to-end complexity analysis of bilevel learning, valid for the most important optimization routines in inverse problems, rather than for a specific choice of methods.

papers.title_en: TIDE: Trajectory-Informed Skill Distillation for Efficient Text-to-Video Prompt Optimization
papers.authors: Chengxing Zhou, Yuliang Huang, Jingwei Song
papers.evidence: 高效的文本到视频提示词优化
papers.tldr: 本文提出了TIDE框架，用于高效优化文本到视频（T2V）模型的提示词。传统方法依赖于昂贵的迭代搜索和视觉语言模型评估，而TIDE通过蒸馏搜索过程，将其转化为可解释、可复用的提示词重写技能，仅需单次大模型调用和单次视频生成即可完成高质量优化。
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video (T2V) models are highly sensitive to prompt specificity, while iterative prompt optimization typically improves generation quality only through repeated video generation and vision-language model evaluation at inference time. We propose TIDE, a framework that distills this costly search process into an interpretable and reusable prompt-rewriting Skill. TIDE formulates prompt rewriting as a set of source-conditioned rule modules, each targeting a distinct semantic dimension. Once distilled, the frozen Skill activates the relevant rules and generates both positive and negative prompts in a single LLM call, followed by only one T2V generation, without test-time visual search or backbone fine-tuning. Evolved using only 100 prompts over 14 hours, TIDE achieves prompt-optimization performance comparable to computationally expensive search-based methods. Moreover, when transferred to previously unseen video-generation models, TIDE outperforms existing approaches specifically designed or trained for those models. Code is available at https://github.com/xiningin/TIDE_T2V.

papers.title_en: REPRO: Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimizer for Automated LLM Red-Teaming
papers.evidence: 用于自动红队测试的进化提示优化
papers.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为REPRO的纯黑盒进化提示词优化框架，用于自动化红队测试以寻找大语言模型的安全漏洞。该方法仅需单张消费级GPU和一个7B开源反射模型，通过语义交叉和基于汤普森采样的贝叶斯策略选择，在多项基准测试中对36个主流目标模型实现了高效的对抗性提示词发现。
papers.abstract_en: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial prompts that bypass their safety training. Existing automated red-teaming methods either require privileged access unavailable in production, rely on manually engineered per-model templates, or optimize a single objective without population-level diversity. We present REPRO (Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimization), a pure black-box framework that discovers adversarial prompts through evolutionary optimization driven entirely by a compressed open-weight 7B reflective model on a single consumer GPU. REPRO introduces two mechanisms absent from prior work, both isolated in a component ablation: semantic crossover, an LLM-guided multi-parent recombination operator, and Bayesian strategy selection via Thompson Sampling informed by structured failure analysis.   We catalog REPRO's behavior on AdvBench, JailbreakBench, and HarmBench across 36 target models from 11 families, including GPT-5-nano, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and Grok-4.1. Under our protocol REPRO reaches 100\% attack success rate (ASR) on every evaluated target in a single turn, at a median of 24 target queries per behavior. Two properties of the protocol qualify that figure. The judge scoring candidates during optimization also produces the reported ASR, and search halts when it accepts, so ASR reports whether search succeeded within the iteration budget rather than success at a fixed budget. All baseline figures are transcribed from their original papers, which use different judges, budgets, and model versions. We therefore present this as a catalog of model coverage under one protocol rather than a head-to-head ranking, and develop both qualifications in the paper.

papers.title_en: PID-Gated Continual Prompt Adaptation Under Noisy Feedback
papers.evidence: 持续提示词自适应与提示词优化器
papers.tldr: 本文研究了在非平稳环境中部署大语言模型代理时，如何应对含噪声反馈进行持续的提示词适应。针对频繁修改导致错误累积的问题，作者借鉴PID控制理论提出了一种轻量级调度门控机制，能够在保证任务性能的同时有效控制编辑器调用成本。
papers.abstract_en: Deploying LLM agents in non-stationary environments requires continually revising their instructions as the task drifts, yet rewriting after every reported mistake can turn noisy feedback into persistent errors. This raises an often-overlooked scheduling question in prompt adaptation: when should feedback trigger a lasting instruction update, and at what editor-call cost? Taking inspiration from proportional-integral-derivative (PID) control, we introduce a family of lightweight gates that react to the current error, accumulate evidence over time, and roll back deterioration after an edit. We benchmark these gates against both simple baselines and advanced prompt optimizers (TextGrad and GEPA), over a diverse suite of drifting tasks, LLM parameter sizes, feedback-noise levels, and random seeds. PID-gated continual prompt adaptation yields a more favorable Pareto trade-off between task performance (high accuracy, low error) and editor-call budget than the baselines considered, pointing to control-theoretic scheduling as a simple, general tool for robust prompt adaptation under unreliable feedback.

papers.title_en: Not All Drift Is a Mechanism: Tracing Prompt Adaptation in LLMs
papers.authors: Mikhail Aleksandrov, Nail Bashirov, Maksim Ivanov, Andrew Tsukanov, Timofey Karyagin, Alexander Miasnikov, Gleb Molodtsov, Valentin Samokhin, Aleksandr Beznosikov
papers.evidence: 比较离散提示优化、提示微调和前缀微调
papers.tldr: 本文研究了离散提示优化、提示微调和前缀微调等大语言模型提示适应方法在内部计算机制上的差异。通过分析不同适应方法对密集模型和混合专家(MoE)模型内部处理的影响，作者发现适应方法的位置决定了任务信息传导至输出的方式，并指出传统的表征漂移测量方法无法可靠地区分有效适应与安慰剂效应。
papers.abstract_en: Prompt-based adaptation offers several ways to specialize a frozen language model, ranging from natural-language prompt optimization to learned continuous prompts. These methods are usually compared through downstream performance, although similar outputs need not arise from similar internal computations. We study how discrete prompt optimization, prompt tuning, and prefix tuning alter the processing of dense and mixture-of-experts language models. Our analysis shows that the location of the adaptation predicts how task information is carried to the output: optimized text primarily changes response construction, input-level prompts write their influence into content representations, and layer-wise prefixes maintain direct control through attention. In MoE models, these differences further induce distinct expert-routing patterns. At the same time, common representation-level measurements respond strongly to generic context changes and do not reliably distinguish useful adaptations from matched placebos. We argue that understanding prompt adaptation requires separating representation drift from the part of that drift that is aligned with, and causally used by, the model's task computation. This perspective provides practical guidance for selecting, evaluating, and interpreting prompt adaptation methods.

papers.title_en: DPOison-VL: Clean Preference Poisoning in Vision-Language Direct Preference Optimization
papers.evidence: 将投毒构造建模为双层优化问题
papers.tldr: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）直接偏好优化（DPO）的安全性进行了研究，首次提出了DPOison-VL干净偏好投毒攻击。该方法仅通过对一小部分训练图像施加肉眼不可察觉的微小扰动，就能在保持提示、回答和偏好标注不变的情况下，静默篡改模型的对齐方向，揭示了VLM-DPO训练数据中的重大安全漏洞。
papers.abstract_en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a widely adopted approach for aligning vision-language models (VLMs), yet the security of multimodal preference data remains largely unexplored. Existing preference poisoning attacks either corrupt explicit supervision signals or require visible triggers, making them detectable under human inspection. We introduce DPOison-VL, the first clean preference poisoning attack against VLM-DPO, which manipulates model alignment solely through imperceptible perturbations on a small fraction of training images, while leaving all prompts, responses, and preference annotations semantically intact. We formulate poison construction as a bilevel optimization and derive a gradient alignment surrogate that efficiently steers image perturbations toward the attacker-specified preference. We further introduce a preference displacement score for principled poison selection with provable first-order optimality under a fixed poison budget, and derive a sufficient condition for preference inversion. Extensive experiments across diverse attack tasks, different VLM architectures and scales, and baseline comparisons demonstrate that DPOison-VL achieves up to 98\% ASR with only 2\% poisoned data and exhibits cross-model transferability, while largely preserving clean accuracy and general utility. Our findings reveal a critical vulnerability in VLM-DPO, where imperceptible image perturbations in preference training data can silently redirect alignment.

papers.title_en: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction
papers.authors: Hanchen Xia, Baoyou Chen, Yutang Ge, Naihao Deng, Senqiao Yang, Zilong Dong, Weihao Yuan, Siyu Zhu
papers.evidence: 生成软记忆标记以逼近历史信息
papers.tldr: 本文针对长视野智能体在有限上下文窗口下历史信息压缩不足的问题，提出了一种名为REMORY的神经记忆网络。该方法通过在文本摘要后附加一组有界软记忆tokens，作为序列维度的残差连接，帮助冻结的大语言模型逼近完整历史的输出。实验表明，REMORY在显著减少输入标记的同时，大幅提升了模型的来源归因准确率、信息覆盖度以及长视野智能体任务的执行稳定性。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1.

papers.title_en: Think in Strategies, Act with Tools: Traceable Agentic Optimization for Combinatorial Problems
papers.authors: Zhongnian Li, Shi Xu, Peng Ying, Weikang Gong, Zhixiao Wang, Xinzheng Xu
papers.evidence: 利用 OPRO 进行基于提示的自动化优化
papers.tldr: 针对大语言模型在组合优化中轨迹难以追踪、解质量受限的问题，本文提出了工具增强的战略智能体（TASA）。该方法通过总结和利用优化轨迹，将优化过程分解为可追踪的策略选择，并结合问题特定工具与策略引导的自适应工具规划器来更新解。实验结果证明了该框架在解质量和策略引导搜索的可追踪性方面的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO) directly leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate candidate solutions through natural-language prompting. However, OPRO's optimization process is difficult to track, which prevents LLMs from capturing useful information accumulated over previous iterations, thereby limiting solution quality. To address this limitation, we propose a Tool-Augmented Strategic Agent (TASA) which summarizes and exploits trajectory to improve solution quality. Specifically, TASA plans the strategy for each step based on the optimization trajectory, which decomposes the optimization process into traceable strategy selections. Moreover, we leverage LLM to construct problem-specific tools and introduce a strategy-guided adaptive tool planner, which efficiently utilizes the information of trajectory to update solutions. We establish local convergence under persistent exploration and evaluate the complete framework under a shared candidate-evaluation budget. The results support its solution quality and the traceability of strategy-guided search.

papers.title_en: SIMPLE: Semantic Structure-Aligned Prompt Learning for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization
papers.authors: Hanyu Xuan, Haoran Xu, Min Yin, Shuo Wang, Cheng Zhao, Kun Li, Fei Wang, Zhiliang Wu, Guanghui Yue, Hehe Fan
papers.evidence: 可学习的提示学习框架
papers.tldr: 本文针对开放词汇视听事件定位中可学习提示词容易出现的语义拓扑漂移问题，提出了一种名为SIMPLE的语义结构对齐提示学习框架。通过结合可学习连续提示微调与语义拓扑一致性正则化，该方法在保持跨模态语义结构的同时实现了数据驱动的提示优化，在OV-AVEBench上以更少的参数和训练时间取得了最先进的性能。
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization aims to infer explicit segment-level categories for both seen and unseen audio-visual events. Existing solutions rely heavily on hand-crafted prompt templates, whose predictions are highly sensitive to subtle wording variations. Learnable prompts remove this manual tuning burden, but when trained solely on seen events, they tend to overfit to seen categories and distort the inter-event semantic topology required for generalization to unseen categories, a failure we term semantic topology drift. In this paper, we propose SIMPLE, a semantic structure-aligned prompt learning framework that aligns cross-category semantic topology between learnable and hand-crafted prompts across asynchronous audio and visual streams. Specifically, our SIMPLE combines Learnable Continuous Prompt Tuning (LCPT) with Semantic Topology Consistency Regularization (STCR). The LCPT automates prompt engineering through data-driven optimization, while the STCR module aligns the category-wise similarity distributions of learnable and hand-crafted prompts under random category subset sampling to alleviate semantic topology drift. Comprehensive experiments and analyses on the OV-AVEBench demonstrate that our SIMPLE framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on the seen and unseen splits, while using roughly half the trainable parameters and roughly one-third the training time.

papers.title_en: Revisiting Natural Language Prompts from Large Language Models for Open-Vocabulary Video Recognition
papers.authors: Haichen He, Weibin Liu, Weiwei Xing
papers.evidence: 利用LLM生成视频识别提示
papers.tldr: 本文针对开放词汇视频识别中视觉-语言模型因文本信息有限易过拟合的问题，提出了P2CLIP方法。该方法通过大语言模型生成高质量提示词，并在类别、视频和帧三个层面增强视觉-文本对齐与时序建模，在零样本和少样本实验中展现出显著的性能优势。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) like CLIP have shown great success in image tasks, however, applying CLIP to open-vocabulary video recognition poses challenges. Due to the limited text information, directly fine-tuning CLIP on video recognition datasets may lead to overfitting and hinder its generalizability. A prevalent method is to enrich text information by generating prompts using Large Language Models (LLMs). However, limited efforts have been made to explore how to generate higher-quality prompts that can contribute to classify unseen categories, and how to further enhance vision-text alignment based on these prompts. In this paper, we propose P2CLIP (Prompt-guided CLIP), which aims to bridge this gap by exploring the impact of prompts across three aspects: category, video, and frame. At the category level, we argue that LLM-generated prompts under simple instructions may suffer from semantic overgeneralization, which can blur the category boundaries and hinder the performance of the model. To address this issue, we design Generic-Discriminative Prompt using LLMs to obtain discriminative category embeddings with rich semantic information. At the video and frame levels, we first use VLM and LLM to generate frame and video descriptions for enhancing vision-text alignment. Then we propose a Knowledge-Guided Temporal Aggregation mechanism, which leverages the expert knowledge derived from LLMs to guide the temporal modeling of videos and encourage a better construction of the joint visual-textual feature space. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks, including zero-shot and few-shot settings, demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

papers.title_en: A Bilevel Market Equilibrium Model for Natural Gas Pipeline Network Operations: Convex Relaxations and Single-level Reformulations
papers.authors: Novel Kumar Dey, Afrooz Jalilzadeh, Erfan Yazdandoost Hamedani, Saif R. Kazi, Anatoly Zlotnik
papers.evidence: 市场均衡的双层优化建模
papers.tldr: 本文提出了一种天然气管道网络运营的双层市场均衡模型，将上层的现货市场价格与流量确定模型与下层的网络流量分配模型有机结合，克服了传统串行求解的局限性。研究引入了凸松弛技术处理非线性管道压力方程和压缩机成本，并通过KKT条件和对偶理论实现了单层重构，验证了模型的高效性与准确性。
papers.abstract_en: We propose an integrated market equilibrium model for determining the spot market prices and flow rates in a natural gas pipeline network. The traditional approach solves the market equilibrium model separately from the natural gas network flow allocation problem in a sequential manner. Our proposed framework synthesizes marketing and operations by using a bilevel optimization formulation where the market equilibrium model in the upper level is connected and simultaneously solved with the natural gas network flow model in the lower level. We introduce convex relaxations for the nonconvex Weymouth pipe pressure drop equation and a surrogate for the compressor operating cost. Furthermore, we compare multiple single level reformulations of the bilevel problem based on Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) optimality conditions, Wolfe duality, and Lagrange duality conditions. Numerical studies on a small 6-node network demonstrates the efficacy and accuracy of our model and the comparison between different duality and optimality based reformulations.

papers.title_en: Using Evidence-Centered Design to Guide Prompt Engineering in Measurement: An Illustration with Automated Essay Scoring
papers.authors: Jiawei Xiong, Cheng Tang, Hong Jiao, Hanna Choi
papers.evidence: 提示词工程的有原则设计
papers.tldr: 本研究针对教育领域生成式AI提示词工程缺乏结构化设计的问题，提出将基于教育测量的证据中心设计（ECD）框架应用于提示词工程中。通过将ECD的核心模型映射到提示词设计组件并推导设计原则，实证研究表明，ECD指导的提示词在自动化评分任务中显著增强了AI生成输出的效度、信度与公平性。
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) models, particularly large language models (LLMs), are increasingly used in educational settings for tasks such as item generation, automated scoring, and feedback delivery. The quality of these outputs depends not only on the AI model but also on how users construct the prompts that guide model behaviors. Current prompt engineering practices are largely ad hoc, relying on trial and error rather than principled design. This lack of structure introduces validity threats including construct misrepresentation, construct-irrelevant variance, and limited reproducibility. We propose that Evidence-Centered Design (ECD), a framework in educational measurement for structuring valid inferences from observed performance, can serve as a principled foundation for prompt engineering in educational applications. We map the three core ECD models, the student model, the evidence model, and the task model, onto the components of educational prompt design, and describe a workflow for ECD-based prompt engineering. We derive five design principles from this mapping and present an empirical study contrasting ECD-designed prompts with state-of-the-art (SOTA) prompting baselines on an automated scoring task. Our empirical study demonstrates the usefulness of this framework on automated scoring. Results suggest that treating prompting as assessment design rather than informal instructions strengthens the validity, reliability, and fairness of AI-generated educational outputs.

papers.title_en: LLM-HB: Language-Aware LLM-Guided Hotword Biasing for Code-Switching ASR
papers.authors: Yuxuan He, Genshun Wan, Pengcheng Li, Gongping Huang, Jianqing Gao, Yanmin Qian
papers.evidence: 基于大语言模型提示的热词注入
papers.tldr: 本文针对代码转换语音识别中由于语言频繁切换导致的识别难题，首次提出了一种基于大语言模型的语言感知热词偏置框架（LLM-HB）。该方法结合了混合专家适配器、辅助语言预测头以及大模型提示词热词注入技术，有效捕捉多语言表征，显著提升了代码转换语音识别的准确率。
papers.abstract_en: Code-switching (CS) speech, characterized by language alternation within a single utterance, is prevalent in multilingual communities and poses challenges to automatic speech recognition (ASR) due to rapid language transitions. We propose LLM-HB, a language-aware large language model-guided hotword biasing framework for code-switching ASR (CS-ASR). The framework incorporates a mixture-of-experts (MoE) adaptor and an auxiliary language prediction head to better capture and differentiate multilingual representations, while hotwords are injected through LLM-based prompting. Experiments on the ASRU2019 code-switching challenge test set demonstrate that LLM-HB achieves a 20.30% relative reduction in mixed error rate (MER) over the baseline, reaching 5.85% MER under a 15-distractor hotword setting. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to integrate LLM-guided biasing into code-switching ASR. We further release the extracted ASRU2019 hotword list to support future research.

papers.title_en: Answer It or Not? Towards Prompt-Adapted Adversarial Images on Vision Language Models
papers.authors: Shunyuan Bai, Yuchen Ren, Le Yang, Chenhao Lin, Chao Shen, Zhengyu Zhao
papers.evidence: 视觉语言模型的提示自适应优化
papers.tldr: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）研究了提示词自适应的对抗图像生成问题。现有的VLM对抗保护往往无差别地拒绝所有问题，无法区分合法和有害查询。为此，本文提出了ProAda（Prompt-Adapted）对抗图像，通过平衡有害提示的拒绝与合法提示的响应，实现了对视觉隐私的精准保护，并在跨模型迁移性和对抗鲁棒性上表现优异。
papers.abstract_en: With the advancement in language modeling, research on adversarial images has recently shifted from image classifiers to vision-language models (VLMs). Despite the new, text-prompt-driven nature of VLMs, we find that existing VLM adversaries have largely overlooked the dynamics of text prompts. In a typical use case, adversarial images can protect visual privacy by rejecting VLMs from answering questions about the image. However, existing protections are prompt-agnostic, i.e., indiscriminately rejecting any question, including those for potential legitimate use of the image. To address this limitation, we propose Prompt-Adapted (ProAda) adversarial images, which are optimized to balance the rejection of harmful prompts and the correct response of legitimate prompts. In particular, to achieve a more accurate adversarial direction, the text prompt is also iteratively updated with a simple classifier judging whether the harmfulness of the prompt remains. Extensive experiments on visual-privacy-related datasets validate that ProAda can reject over 90% of harmful prompts while allowing over 90% of legitimate ones, demonstrating superior overall performance compared to existing prompt-agnostic VLM adversaries. In addition, our ProAda achieves competitive overall cross-model transferability and improved robustness against countermeasures.

papers.title_en: Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of LLMs in Learnable Low-Rank Subspaces
papers.evidence: 在可学习低秩子空间中进行内存高效的微调
papers.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为AdaSub-ZO的新型大模型零阶微调框架，旨在解决传统零阶优化在高维参数空间中方差大、随机子空间与任务方向不匹配的问题。该方法通过从有限差分反馈中迭代学习逐层投影矩阵，并引入子空间动量加速机制，显著降低了梯度估计方差并加速了收敛。
papers.abstract_en: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). However, ZO optimization suffers from high variance in high-dimensional parameter spaces. While recent methods restrict perturbations to random low-rank subspaces, these subspaces often misalign with task-specific descent directions. We propose AdaSub-ZO, a novel forward-only fine-tuning framework in learnable low-rank subspaces. Instead of relying on fixed random matrices, AdaSub-ZO iteratively learns layer-wise projection matrices directly from finite-difference feedback to track task-aware descent directions. Furthermore, AdaSub-ZO incorporates a subspace momentum acceleration mechanism to smooth noisy gradient estimates across evolving subspace bases. Extensive experiments on natural language understanding tasks demonstrate that AdaSub-ZO outperforms existing ZO baselines, substantially reducing gradient estimation variance and accelerating convergence.

papers.title_en: LLM Agents for Automated Post-Training via Structured Recipe Optimization
papers.authors: Ruohong Liu, Bohan Tang, Lekang Jiang, Jack Umenberger, Yiwen Guo
papers.evidence: 通过结构化配方优化实现自动后训练
papers.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型智能体的结构化方案优化（SRO）方法，用于自动化大模型后训练。该方法通过动态构建任务自适应的方案空间并进行联合优化，解决了传统自动化方法在空间适应性和系统性重用方面的局限，在多个能力域和基准测试中展现出显著的性能优势。
papers.abstract_en: Automated post-training transforms pre-trained large language models (LLMs) into models capable of handling diverse domains by automatically constructing and optimizing a recipe of coupled decisions over data sources, data processing, cross-domain composition, and training configuration under a limited experimental budget. Existing automation either searches predefined recipe spaces that enable systematic optimization but remain fixed rather than adapting their available choices to the target tasks, or uses open-ended agents that discover task-specific choices but leave them implicit in trial-level edits, limiting their systematic reuse and recombination across trials. To fill this gap, we introduce optimization over a task-adapted recipe space, a novel paradigm that can adapt the recipe space itself to the target tasks while representing its choices explicitly for systematic reuse, recombination, and joint optimization. We instantiate this paradigm with Structured Recipe Optimization (SRO), comprising an LLM-based Recipe-Space Designer that constructs the task-adapted recipe space and a Multi-Domain Recipe Optimizer that uses structured trial evidence to guide LLM candidate construction and multi-objective Bayesian trial selection. Extensive experiments show that SRO achieves the highest average score in all evaluated target-model and agent-LLM combinations. In joint post-training across three capability domains and six benchmarks, SRO reaches 41.1 versus 15.4 for the strongest baseline on Qwen3-1.7B with GPT-5.4, and 53.8 versus 40.8 on Qwen3-4B with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Our code is available at https://github.com/RuohLiuq/SRO.

papers.title_en: Back-Translation Still Matters: Leveraging Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLMs
papers.authors: Divyanshu Bathla, Parag Singla, Jitin Singla
papers.evidence: 机器翻译中的少样本提示
papers.tldr: 该论文探讨了在低资源机器翻译中如何有效利用单语数据，发现传统的反向翻译（BT）技术配合大语言模型微调，比持续预训练或单纯增加平行数据更具优势，能显著提升翻译质量并得到人工评估的验证。
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained Large Language Model (LLMs) are effective on many tasks in zero-shot and few-shot settings. For machine translation of low-resource languages, the obvious options are few-shot prompting and fine-tuning on a small parallel set. We ask: what if moderate amounts of low-resource monolingual data are also available? We argue that, rather than continued pretraining, a more effective use of this data is the pre-LLM era technique of back-translation (BT). The current fine-tuned LLM translates monolingual sentences in each language, and the resulting pairs train it in the reverse direction. Updates on the parallel set are interleaved for stable learning. With 1K parallel pairs on Odia and Swahili, BT beats continued pretraining into the low-resource language by 7.7 to 16.4 XCOMET-XXL points in domain. With beam-decoded intermediate translations, it also beats a model with 10 time more parallel data. In-context examples retrieved from the parallel data further improve BT. We also analyze the source, quality and amount of monolingual text. Across five low-resource languages, with Hindi as a high-resource control, and two 3B backbones, BT improves translation into the low-resource language by 16 to 173% XCOMET-XXL over parallel-only fine-tuning. Blind human evaluation on Odia and Sanskrit agrees with the automatic metrics.
